messages:
Maria (partnerships): Quick heads-up — vendor pre-announce wedge incoming for H100/H200 + B200. Nvidia told partners there may be a microcode push targeting late March that shifts some slots. We should update marketplace preannounce and SI handshake notes. @Ian (hw-eng) can you confirm the specific driver/firmware thresholds?
Ian (hw-eng): On it. Preliminary: FW bump from 1.2.3 -> 1.3.0. Affects ECC timings and memory init; driver requirement moves to 525.7+. Impact: a subset of H200 SKU will need a minimum driver. Will validate exact sku list by EOD.
Kevin (platform): Good to know. Ops implication: we need a new canary image + marketplace tag. Proposed tag: `redwood/gpu-image:preannounce-wedge-2026-03-canary`. Will schedule a canary deploy after Ian confirms driver list.
Devon (sre): Thermal note from Gaudi team: long-sequence derate observed when sustained TDP hits 95%. For the wedge we should cap max-concurrent-per-node from 8 -> 6 to preserve tail-latency SLO. Also recommend a temporary throttling hook in runtime config.
Priya (product): For SI partners and marketplace copy: draft blurb — "Availability may be staggered by region & firmware readiness; partner integrations could be phased. Customers will see SKU notes for driver/firmware requirements." Any objections?
Tom (eng): One more: MI300 quantization path change. To avoid perf regressions under the new driver, we'll expose a fallback model mapping for a short window (q8-variant -> q4-safe). I'll post mapping in the repo.
Maria (partnerships): Thanks. I want a concrete rollback/fallback routing policy for the public API and Dedicated pools. Proposal: primary: H100 (fw>=1.3.0) -> fallback: H200-lite (driver-compatible) -> final fallback: smaller open model on CPU. Draft policy snippet below for ops team:
```json
{
  "routing_policy": "firmware_aware",
  "steps": [
    {"match": "fw>=1.3.0 & sku==H100", "route": "H100"},
    {"match": "driver>=525.7 & sku in H200_family", "route": "H200-lite"},
    {"match": "else", "route": "cpu-small-fallback"}
  ]
}
```
Maria (partnerships): Can @Kevin (platform) wire that into the canary routing rules and add a telemetry tag so we can measure fallthroughs?
Kevin (platform): Yep — will add a metric `marketplace.fallthrough.count` and a tag `preannounce_wedge:2026-03`. Canary image + routing hooks planned for 2026-03-29 04:00 UTC.
Ian (hw-eng): SKU list: will post in the partner spreadsheet. Short summary: H100 SKU IDs A1-A4 unaffected, H200 SKU IDs B1-B3 need driver 525.7+, B4 flagged for later.
Devon (sre): Ops runbook quick checklist: 1) Canary deploy, 2) monitor tail-latency and core temp, 3) ramp if <1% fallthroughs, 4) rollback if >5% error rate or >90% thermal derate. I'll paste the run command:
```
# canary deploy
kubectl apply -f gpu-image-canary.yaml --namespace marketplace-canary
watch -n 10 kubectl top pods -n marketplace-canary
```
Priya (product): For SI comms: I'll draft a short email/handbook entry for partners explaining phased availability and required driver/firmware. Will share in #partners-docs for review.
Tom (eng): I'll add the fallback model mapping and a quick eval to ensure quality delta < 3% on our eval set.
release-bot: Deploy scheduled: marketplace-slot-update v1.2 -> 2026-03-29T04:00:00Z (canary), full roll planned 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z.
Maria (partnerships): Action items recap: Ian — publish SKU-driver matrix by EOD; Kevin — push canary image & routing hooks; Devon — finalize runbook thresholds; Priya — partner comms draft; Tom — fallback model mapping + eval. Ping me when done and we'll sync 1:1 before canary. :thumbsup:
